scope: Official public product materials and published design guidance, not authenticated native-app audits.

entries.observed: Developer promotional screens use light surfaces with a purple booking control; the mark is black and white. Service categories use labels and imagery.
entries.apply: Keep browsing surfaces quiet and make the current booking action unmistakable.
entries.avoid: Do not copy the purple, mark, layout, service imagery or icons.
entries.limitation: Promotional imagery does not establish every current screen, region or native state.

sources.title: Urban Company
sources.evidenceClaim: Official category scope and public service presentation.

sources.title: Urban Company developer listing
sources.evidenceClaim: Vendor-authored promotional light surfaces and purple booking action.

entries.observed: The publicly hosted guide names orange #FF5200, white #FFFFFF and pale Salt #FFEDE3. Promotional slides distinguish services with contextual colour families.
entries.apply: Separate recognition colour, action roles and product/category accents.
entries.avoid: Do not borrow the orange identity, sub-brand graphics or promotional composition.
entries.limitation: Guide metadata indicates creation in 2025; latest revision and authenticated app implementation were not established.

sources.title: Masterbrand Internal Guidelines, pages21 and24
sources.evidenceClaim: Named brand swatches and illustrated button treatments.

entries.observed: Public promotional material combines yellow, black and green; a light support panel uses green links.
entries.apply: Brand expression need not be the same as every functional accent.
entries.avoid: Do not copy the yellow-green mark, graphics or make category/status meaning depend on the brand hue.
entries.limitation: Purchase-action colour and authenticated checkout were not verified.

sources.title: Blinkit developer listing
sources.evidenceClaim: Vendor yellow branding and light support panel with green links.

entries.observed: Official release examples and store promotion show a pink-red mark, light booking views, labelled photographic categories, and context-specific pink or dark actions.
entries.apply: Test action emphasis across booking contexts; keep content and category labels legible.
entries.avoid: Do not clone the mark, booking composition, photography or signature colour treatment.
entries.limitation: Release illustrations/store promotion are not an audit of every live native booking state.

sources.title: Airbnb 2026 Fall Update
sources.evidenceClaim: Published light booking examples and context-specific actions.

sources.title: Airbnb developer listing
sources.evidenceClaim: Vendor app identity and labelled travel offerings.

entries.observed: Developer promotion frames light product views with black-and-white branding and contextual green/gold. Separate Uber Direct collateral illustrates a dark action.
entries.apply: One neutral product base can support multiple service contexts without recolouring every card.
entries.avoid: Do not reuse the mark, membership/grocery palette, promotional frames or graphics.
entries.limitation: Rider promotional views and merchant collateral are distinct contexts; current rider checkout was not audited.

sources.title: Uber developer listing
sources.evidenceClaim: Vendor neutral branding, light app views and contextual accents.

sources.title: Delivery decoded: Uber Direct
sources.evidenceClaim: Merchant marketing example of a dark action on a contrasting promotional surface.

entries.observed: Published guidance uses dynamic foreground/background roles and appearance variants; accents emphasize controls and colour needs supporting meaning.
entries.apply: Specify paired light/dark roles and retain text/symbol cues.
entries.avoid: Do not assume copying platform colour values creates a distinctive consumer brand.
entries.limitation: Platform guidance, not competitor marketplace research or a prescription to force dark mode.

sources.title: Human Interface Guidelines: Color
sources.evidenceClaim: Dynamic roles, appearance variants, accent use and non-colour cues.

entries.observed: Official guidance distinguishes accent, semantic and surface roles with paired container/foreground colours and light/dark schemes.
entries.apply: Evaluate real foreground/background usage pairs, not isolated brand swatches.
entries.avoid: Do not copy a sample palette or invent category colours from a generic system.
entries.limitation: General platform guidance; no particular marketplace/category hues are prescribed.

sources.title: Android colour for mobile design
sources.evidenceClaim: Accent/semantic/surface role separation and light/dark paired roles.

entries.observed: Merchant-admin guidance reserves colours for state, uses neutral text/category chips, and illustrates a dark action on a light card.
entries.apply: Keep merchant/admin pages neutral; distinguish category decoration from status.
entries.avoid: Do not import Shopify-specific status meanings or copy its exact interface.
entries.limitation: Merchant-admin design context, not a universal consumer-app colour policy.

sources.title: Shopify app visual design
sources.evidenceClaim: Neutral text, semantic status, category chips and contrast guidance.

entries.observed: Vendor-published store images show blue promotional framing, a white booking card and a blue outlined Select room action; product photography remains content rather than page decoration.
entries.apply: Treat blue as a credible booking/action direction and keep product surfaces legible; brand distinctiveness still needs Oorva's own mark and composition.
entries.avoid: Do not copy the logo, photography, promotional layout, rewards or discount claims.
entries.limitation: Two official developer promotional images inspected; these do not establish current authenticated checkout or all blue values.

sources.title: Booking.com developer listing and promotional images
sources.evidenceClaim: Vendor blue-framed promotional material and white card with blue outlined booking action; exact brand hex not inferred.

guidance.title: WCAG2.2 Contrast Minimum
guidance.evidenceClaim: 4.5:1 normal text;3:1 qualifying large text; specified exceptions; thresholds use unrounded results.

guidance.title: WCAG2.2 Non-text Contrast
guidance.evidenceClaim: Applicable meaningful visual control/state/graphic cues require3:1 against adjacent colours.

guidance.title: WCAG2.2 Use of Color
guidance.evidenceClaim: Do not make colour the sole visible cue for meaning, actions or required information.

interpretationBoundary: Oorva principles and all concept scores are design judgments, not verified causal effects, Indian consumer preference, conversion measurements or trademark clearance.
